faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Is the content actually accurate to Scripture?
faq.a1: Yes. Every generation is grounded in Scripture and reviewed prompts designed to stay faithful to biblical principles — you can always edit before you post.
faq.q2: Can my whole church team use one account?
faq.a2: Yes, on the Pro plan. Invite your team to a shared workspace with contacts, events, communications, and finances.
faq.a3: You keep access until the end of your current billing period, and you can resubscribe anytime — nothing is deleted.
faq.q4: Do I need any design experience?
faq.a4: No. Describe what you need in plain language and Zyonix generates ready-to-post art, captions, and outlines.
faq.a5: Zyonix is available in English and Spanish, with more languages on the way.
faq.a6: Each plan includes a monthly allowance of image, text, and video credits that refresh every cycle — no surprise overage charges.
faq.a7: Yes. Every plan includes a {days}-day money-back guarantee. If Zyonix isn't for you, request a refund within {days} days of purchase through Hotmart or by writing to support@zyonix.pro.
faq.q8: Are my prayer journal and spiritual chat private?
faq.a8: Yes. They are visible only to you, never to teammates or team admins, even on the Pro plan. You can download or delete everything from Settings at any time.
